name: soundId
meaning: Sample id from the .SND entry header, compared (as u32) against Sound_Play's soundId. Array g_sndBankEntries 0x6deff0, stride 0xc, capacity 256.

name: dataSize
meaning: Byte length of the RIFF/WAVE image following the 12-byte entry header in the .SND file. Passed to WaveFile_Open(mem, 1, size) and used to step to the next entry.

name: loop
meaning: == 1 forces StaticSound.looping on in Sound_Play, even without playFlags bit 1.
